messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#INC-20318. Metric: inference-gateway-usw2 5xx-rate jumped to 7.8% over 5m (threshold 1.0%). Auto-page to oncall and eng-sre. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-20318 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-20318 created and assigned to sam.oncall (primary). Escalation policy: 10m -> eng-sre.

sara: acked. I'm on it, standing up a runbook thread. Anyone seeing dashboards?

leo: looking. Confirming spike across both canary and prod pools. Quick snapshot:
```
5m window: total requests 120k
5xx count 9.3k -> 7.8%  (baseline 0.4%)
Top origin: /v1/generate (70%)
Region: usw2 primary
Error class: 502/504 mix
```

ana: tagging @mike for gateway routing — might be a proxy downgrade (recent envoy config pushed 18m ago).

mike: i pushed an envoy route weight tweak 18m ago, rolling it back now for canary. Will post status.

jamie: adding context — we've seen a rising retry storm from clients after a short 502 window earlier. KV cache pressure looked higher in the last hour. Runbook suggests: 1) scale pods, 2) warm kvcache, 3) rollback recent route changes.

sara: performing canary rollback (route weight -> 0) and scaling inference-gateway-deployment x2. Commands:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference-gateway gateway:v2026.03.12
kubectl -n prod scale deploy inference-gateway --replicas=24
```

sara: posted runbook link: https://confluence.example.com/pages/runbooks/inference-5xx-surge

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: sam.oncall ack (primary). Escalation timer paused.

leo: curl test after rollback:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
-> 200
```

mike: envoy rollback finished on canary, propagation looks healthy. Replacing listeners on 2 nodes.

jamie: telemetry update: 5xx-rate dropped to 2.1% in 2m after rollback/scale. Still above baseline but trending down. Customer-impact estimate: ~2% of requests failing end-to-end, primarily short-lived 502s for heavy token lengths.

ana: flagged top 10 customers by error-rate and sent automated emails via customer-impact system. No SEV yet but support channels are getting a few tickets.

sara: starting a short mitigation window: increase retry-backoff at gateway for 60m, disable aggressive client retries in edge config.

mike: applied backoff patch: set `max_retries=2`, `retry_timeout_ms=250` on edge-proxy cluster.

leo: investigating root cause: tracing shows that some requests hit a chain of slow KV cache misses and triggered timeouts in the model sidecar. There was a small memory pressure event on two GPU hosts. Logs: `kvcache: eviction_count spike -> 8k`

jamie: filing follow-up ticket for host memory tunables + improve kvcache LRU. For now we should keep scaled replicas and monitor.

incident-bot: Reminder: Escalation to eng-sre in 6m if error rate > 2.5% persists.

sara: planning a canary validation: run synthetic prompts with long sequences to exercise KV cache. If green in 10m, we'll mark incident as mitigated.

mike: synthetic run: 50 requests long-token -> 48/50 200, 2/50 transient 502

leo: metrics: 5xx-rate at 0.9% now. Rolling back scale to baseline will be deferred until 60m of stable metrics.

jamie: note for postmortem: correlate envoy route change at T-18m with memory pressure window at T-20m -> likely combined.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-20318 status updated: acknowledged -> monitored. No further escalations.

sara: marking the thread as mitigation in progress. Please ping if you see customer-impact increase.

ana: thanks all. I'll prepare a support summary for customers affected and include preventative actions.

mike: leaving a short snippet for ops log:
```
Action: rolled back envoy route weight (canary -> 0)
Action: scaled inference-gateway 18 -> 24 replicas
Action: applied edge retry backoff patch
Result: 5xx-rate decreased from 7.8% -> 0.9% over 20m
```

sara: closing pager on our side in 30m if stable. tagging this thread for postmortem owners: jamie, leo, mike. :white_check_mark:
